author: reek
body: Known-answer test for the T-SQL emitter. The model is the star from the planner test: orders is the fact, users the dimension table, one many-to-one join between them, and the column names carry hyphens on purpose so every emitted reference exercises bracket quoting. Each query below runs through lens-plan, so the emitter is fed exactly the trees the planner builds, and the emitted statement is pinned as text.

author: reek
body: The pins cover the planner's whole emission surface. Revenue by city is the three-step grain ladder: a GROUP BY at the orders grain inside a derived table, an INNER JOIN to users on the join key, and a re-aggregation by city, crowned by projection and an ascending sort. The fan-out query adds a second measure aggregated at the users grain and joined on the full dimension column set. The filtered query pushes its predicate inside the derived table under the revenue group, where raw-row grain lives. The limited query renders TOP inside the projection head. The dimensionless query glues two single-row aggregates with CROSS JOIN. The quoted filter carries a single quote in its literal and must double it.

author: reek
body: A planned query renders as its emitted statement; a refused query renders its diagnostics so a planner regression is visible here too.
